identity_cues.temperament: Attentive, competitive, and careful about admitting uncertainty.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She learns transitions quickly and asks to repeat the exchange that exposed her guard.

identity_cues.appearance: A lean man with long forearms and a repaired practice scabbard.
identity_cues.temperament: Patient, methodical, and difficult to provoke.

identity_cues.appearance: A narrow-faced woman with a high braid and old rope burns across two fingers.
identity_cues.temperament: Quietly stubborn and unusually observant of other trainees.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She treats footwork errors as information and rarely repeats the same mistake twice.

identity_cues.appearance: Broad-backed with a shaved jaw and a carpenter's careful hands.
identity_cues.temperament: Practical, direct, and slow to waste effort.

identity_cues.appearance: A rangy woman with a faint burn mark along one wrist.
identity_cues.temperament: Dryly humorous, disciplined, and quick to question unsafe habits.

identity_cues.appearance: Short and wiry, with close-cut hair and a habit of retightening every knot.
identity_cues.temperament: Precise, reserved, and persistently curious.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: They break complex sequences into small repeatable timings.

identity_cues.appearance: A tall youth with a freckled nose and scuffed training sandals.
identity_cues.temperament: Earnest, restless, and responsive to exact correction.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He attacks drills at full pace until an instructor makes him earn the pace through control.

identity_cues.appearance: A sturdy woman with a low ponytail and an old fracture ridge on one knuckle.
identity_cues.temperament: Calm, skeptical, and protective of weaker partners.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She naturally closes gaps in a formation before chasing her own opening.

identity_cues.appearance: Square-shouldered with neatly trimmed hair and ink stains under one thumbnail.
identity_cues.temperament: Analytical, formal, and more comfortable with demonstrated rules than slogans.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He keeps mental counts of timing and immediately notices inconsistent signals.

identity_cues.appearance: Long-legged and light-framed, with a pale scar near the right eyebrow.
identity_cues.temperament: Adaptable, sociable, and serious once practice begins.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: They learn fastest through live opposition and ask partners to vary the problem.

identity_cues.appearance: A muscular woman with weathered hands and a plain cloth sword wrap.
identity_cues.temperament: Steady, unsentimental, and patient with repetition.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She values balance, recovery, and the ability to keep working after a failed exchange.

identity_cues.appearance: A narrow-shouldered man with quick hands and a chipped front tooth.
identity_cues.temperament: Good-natured, alert, and intensely competitive against the clock.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He likes timed drills but accepts penalties for sloppy control without argument.

identity_cues.appearance: A small woman with dark curls tied behind a cloth band.
identity_cues.temperament: Cautious, thoughtful, and hard to surprise twice.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She studies the setup before committing and remembers exactly where pressure first appeared.

identity_cues.appearance: A broad-faced man with a runner's build and old blisters across both heels.
identity_cues.temperament: Cheerful outside drills, focused and economical inside them.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He treats movement as positioning rather than display and hates wasted steps.

identity_cues.appearance: A tall woman with an undercut and a habit of rolling her shoulders before sparring.
identity_cues.temperament: Frank, composed, and willing to ask for harder opposition.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She reinforces strengths by testing whether they still hold when footing and timing worsen.

identity_cues.appearance: A weathered man with a narrow beard and a careful, upright stance.
identity_cues.temperament: Self-contained, reliable, and intolerant of careless weapon handling.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He treats safety, maintenance, and readiness as part of martial skill rather than chores.

identity_cues.appearance: A quick-moving woman with short bangs and a faded cloth brace around one wrist.
identity_cues.temperament: Wry, attentive, and comfortable correcting peers.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She turns partner feedback into immediate adjustment instead of defending the failed technique.

identity_cues.appearance: A long-faced trainee with silver-rimmed reading lenses worn only off the floor.
identity_cues.temperament: Measured, inquisitive, and unusually good at remembering sequences.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: They connect technical drills to larger formation problems and ask what each movement protects.

identity_cues.appearance: A stocky young man with thick eyebrows and a rough patch sewn into one sleeve.
identity_cues.temperament: Persistent, literal, and happier with measurable standards than praise.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He repeats fundamentals until the correction survives fatigue.

identity_cues.appearance: A slight woman with a straight bob and a pair of carefully maintained practice gloves.
identity_cues.temperament: Reserved, quick-thinking, and more assertive during structured drills.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She uses feints sparingly and prefers to win position before speed.

identity_cues.appearance: A heavy-set man with a scarred left forearm and a stable low stance.
identity_cues.temperament: Patient, grounded, and difficult to rush into a bad decision.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He specializes in keeping structure intact when a drill becomes chaotic.

identity_cues.appearance: A lean trainee with braided hair and a small notebook tucked into a belt pouch.
identity_cues.temperament: Curious, candid, and highly responsive to debriefs.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: They record recurring errors and deliberately design the next repetition around them.

identity_cues.appearance: A poised woman with strong shoulders and a neatly repaired forearm guard.
identity_cues.temperament: Controlled, competitive, and quietly protective of standards.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She pushes strong techniques into unfamiliar angles rather than polishing only comfortable forms.

identity_cues.appearance: A narrow-waisted man with a runner's posture and close-cropped hair.
identity_cues.temperament: Energetic, observant, and quick to volunteer for live opposition.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He learns by forcing transitions between pursuit, restraint, and withdrawal.

identity_cues.appearance: A compact woman with a calm gaze and several small sewing repairs on her training coat.
identity_cues.temperament: Unflappable, practical, and attentive to group rhythm.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She notices when a team's spacing degrades and corrects the formation before chasing individual success.

identity_cues.appearance: A tall man with a crooked nose and carefully wrapped ankles.
identity_cues.temperament: Disciplined, understated, and willing to repeat basics without complaint.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He treats foot placement and breath control as the base of every harder technique.

identity_cues.appearance: A bright-eyed woman with a short ponytail and chalk marks across one sleeve.
identity_cues.temperament: Sociable, focused, and comfortable asking direct questions.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She seeks the reason behind corrections, then tests the principle under pressure.

identity_cues.appearance: A lean man with long fingers and a faded scar across the back of one hand.
identity_cues.temperament: Quiet, exacting, and unusually patient with technical repetition.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He values clean weapon alignment and refuses to trade precision for theatrical speed.

identity_cues.appearance: A broad-smiling woman with muscular calves and a simple wooden hairpin.
identity_cues.temperament: Open, resilient, and serious about partner safety.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She likes hard conditioning but measures success by whether technique survives it.

identity_cues.appearance: A lanky youth with a long fringe and multiple careful patches on his training trousers.
identity_cues.temperament: Shy, persistent, and increasingly assertive once given a defined role.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He improves fastest when responsibility for a partner or lane makes the drill concrete.

identity_cues.appearance: A composed woman with a strong jaw and a weather-darkened practice belt.
identity_cues.temperament: Independent, observant, and comfortable disagreeing respectfully.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: She tests assumptions in debrief and then proves or discards them on the floor.

identity_cues.appearance: A medium-built man with a shaved head and a small notch in one ear.
identity_cues.temperament: Even-tempered, cooperative, and competitive without showmanship.
identity_cues.doctrine_expression: He measures his own success by whether the whole pair exits the exchange in control.
